data.title: Practice
data.instruction: Fill in the blanks with the present perfect form of the verb.

narration: Now it is your turn. Fill in each blank with the present perfect form of the verb in brackets. Try both sentences on your own first. Ready? {{b1.1}} The first answer is: Ravi has lost his pen. Ravi is singular, so has, and lost is the third form of lose. {{b1.2}} And the second: We have visited Agra twice. We is plural, so have, and visited is the third form of visit. How many did you get right?
